experience.title: Computer Engineering Intern

Implemented role-based authorization with JWT and refresh token management integrated via Axios Interceptors.

experience.title: Computer Engineering Intern
bullets: Developed HemenOto, an end-to-end commercial truck rental management application using ASP.NET Core API.
Built upon Onion Architecture, enforcing strict dependency inversion across Presentation, Application, Domain, and Infrastructure layers.
Applied CQRS and Mediator pattern to decouple read/write operations and streamline cross-layer communication.
Designed the relational database schema in MSSQL and integrated real-time data synchronization via SignalR.

projects.name: Turkish Named Entity Recognition

projects.name: Central Hospital Appointment System

projects.name: Cross-Eyed Test
